# Ground_Reaction_Forces

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Source GRF cycles; world force axes and source phase mappings are documented. These forces are never applied as driving inputs.

- [grf.tsv](grf.tsv) — Reference force cycles for all four paws, in newtons. Column labels identify limb, axis and whether the reference is recorded or assumed.
